role: Additional explicit known-domain adaptation comparison; no replacement of domain-blind joint experiments
domain_metadata: Hospital A/B or admission-source grouping is observable before outcomes. Same routing metadata supplied to Base, Shared, Specific. This is NOT unknown-domain inference.
source_id_development: Same held-out half source-calibration rows as jointv14; never fit on these in v16
calibration_contexts: ID contexts use unlabeled source-calibration covariates for support; OOD contexts use unlabeled target covariates, explicit transductive protocol
decision_thresholds: Base threshold learned on calibration only per known domain; shared/specific use SAME Base threshold within each domain
base: Best per-domain development accuracy over source-only/source+32target contexts and two calibration weights; never weakened
selection: Per-domain development accuracy only; candidate fallback allowed. No tests or metric-band filters.
representation: raw; no learned projection in this additional version
